title: celtis leveillei
intro: Celtis leveillei, commonly known as the Chinese hackberry or Chinese nettle tree, is a plant species native to China, used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Celtis leveillei include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and improve blood flow. The bioactive constituents of Celtis leveillei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
